data.spiritual_significance: The name Thomas holds spiritual significance for Christians, as it is a reminder of the doubts and challenges that one may face in their faith journey. The story of Thomas encourages individuals to remain steadfast in their belief, even in the face of uncertainty or challenge, and to trust in the power and promise of God.
